formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list already normalized (synonym variants are single entries); positions cited are normalized one-based positions (ID-2), identical to the packet order.

cleansingStrength.rationale: `moderate` by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2, prominent buffers Lauryl Glucoside@3 (nonionic glucoside) and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate@4 (mild anionic), no reinforcing strong anionic. Cocamidopropyl Betaine@15 is after the E3 point (recorded, not a buffer); Laureth-4@16 ethoxylate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: `low`: cleansing-led architecture; the only conditioning polymer, Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride@13 (cationic, 6.3), and the pearlizer Glycol Distearate@12 sit after the fragrance marker; Glycerin@19 is last; Sodium Lactate@10 is a pH buffer, not a C2 humectant. No silicone, lipid or refatter. Neighbor `moderate`: cationic starch plus pearlizer and glycerin could add up to bounded care.
